name: API 2500
notes: Probed 2026-11-23. Attack, ratio and release are stepped and read from their labels. Release "Vari" (the Release Vari knob) isn't carried: going to the 2500 picks the nearest fixed release.
Knee, Thrust, Type and the link controls have no match on other compressors and stay as they are. Gain is the make-up (out), with Gain Enable left alone.
